    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">手把手教你如何用yolo算法进行运动监测</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3687401/202509/3687401-20250910110941438-1171511522.png" alt="手把手教你如何用yolo算法进行运动监测" class="desc_img">
        本文介绍了一个基于YOLO算法的运动监测项目，通过识别人体17个关键关节节点，实现对俯卧撑、深蹲等动作的自动计数。项目使用Python+OpenCV+Ultralytics解决方案，核心原理是通过分析关节弯曲角度变化（如俯卧撑监测肩膀、肘部、手腕的角度）来识别动作状态并计数。文章详细解析了代码实现流程，包括视频读取、AIGym对象初始化、帧处理循环等，并展示了不同动作（深蹲、压腿、高抬腿）的监测示例。该项目适合计算机视觉和体育健康领域的爱好者，可根据实际需求调整关键点、模型和角度阈值参数。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span data-cke-copybin-start="1">​</span></p>
<h2 id="%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91%E6%BC%94%E7%A4%BA">视频演示</h2>
<p><a title="手把手教你如何用yolo算法进行运动监测" href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1wnHyzPEvM" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1wnHyzPEvM</a></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>大家好，我是Coding茶水间。</p>
<p>今天分享一个基于YOLO算法的运动监测项目，通过识别人体关键关节节点，实现对俯卧撑、深蹲、压腿和高抬腿等动作的自动计数。</p>
<p>视频演示中，我们可以看到实时标注关节点、计算弯曲角度，并统计动作次数。这是一个简单实用的AI应用，适合计算机视觉和体育健康领域的爱好者。</p>
<h2 id="%E9%A1%B9%E7%9B%AE%E6%95%88%E6%9E%9C%E6%BC%94%E7%A4%BA">项目效果演示</h2>
<p>在视频开头，我们看到一个俯卧撑监测的示例：程序用红色圆圈标注肩膀、肘部和手腕，并显示弯曲角度。随着角度变化，动作次数实时更新，最终计数为4次。</p>
<p><img alt="图2" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3687401/202509/3687401-20250910110639526-520099568.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="%E6%A0%B8%E5%BF%83%E5%8E%9F%E7%90%86%EF%BC%9A%E4%BA%BA%E4%BD%93%E5%85%B3%E9%94%AE%E5%85%B3%E8%8A%82%E8%8A%82%E7%82%B9%E8%AF%86%E5%88%AB">核心原理：人体关键关节节点识别</h2>
<p>YOLO算法将人体关节分为17个关键节点，包括眼睛、鼻子、耳朵、肩膀、肘部、手腕、髋关节、膝盖和脚踝等。通过识别这些节点的位置，分析关节间的弯曲角度，来判断动作姿态和计数。</p>
<p><img alt="keypoints-order-ultralytics-yolov8-pose" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3687401/202509/3687401-20250910110659442-987263434.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>对于俯卧撑，我们重点识别左臂的肩膀（节点5）、肘部（节点7）和手腕（节点9）。</p>
<p>弯曲角度如152度时，表示伸展状态；</p>
<p>角度变化用于计数。</p>
<p>类似地，其他动作选择相应节点：</p>
<ul>
<li>深蹲：肩膀（6）、髋关节（12）、膝盖（14）</li>
<li>压腿：髋关节（11）、膝盖（13）、脚踝（15）</li>
<li>高抬腿：髋关节（12）、膝盖（14）、脚踝（16）</li>
</ul>
<p>原理是通过三个核心节点的弯曲情况，监测伸展（up）和收缩（down）状态。</p>
<p>一旦完成一个周期，计数加1。</p>
<h2 id="%E4%BB%A3%E7%A0%81%E5%AE%9E%E7%8E%B0">代码实现</h2>
<p>我们使用Python、OpenCV和Ultralytics的solutions包。核心是AIGym类，用于运动监测。以下是完整代码（以俯卧撑为例）：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" tabindex="-1" role="region" contenteditable="false" aria-label="代码段 小部件" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="8" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element highlighter-hljs" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22lang%22%3A%22python%22%2C%22code%22%3A%22import%20cv2%5Cn%5Cnfrom%20ultralytics%20import%20solutions%5Cn%5Cn%23%20%E8%AF%BB%E5%8F%96%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91%5Cncap%20%3D%20cv2.VideoCapture(%5C%22Pushups.demo.video.mp4%5C%22)%5Cn%23%20%E5%88%A4%E6%96%AD%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91%E6%98%AF%E5%90%A6%E8%AF%BB%E5%8F%96%E6%88%90%E5%8A%9F%5Cnassert%20cap.isOpened()%2C%20%5C%22Error%20reading%20video%20file%5C%22%5Cn%5Cn%23%20%E5%88%9D%E5%A7%8B%E5%8C%96AIGym%5Cngym%20%3D%20solutions.AIGym(%5Cn%20%20%20%20show%3DTrue%2C%20%20%23%20%E5%B1%95%E7%A4%BA%E6%95%88%E6%9E%9C%5Cn%20%20%20%20kpts%3D%5B5%2C%207%2C%209%5D%2C%20%20%23%20%E5%A4%84%E7%90%86%E7%9A%84%E5%85%B3%E9%94%AE%E7%82%B9%5Cn%20%20%20%20model%3D%5C%22yolo11x-pose.pt%5C%22%2C%20%20%23%20%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E8%B7%AF%E5%BE%84%5Cn%20%20%20%20%23%20up_angle%20%3D%20145%2C%5Cn%20%20%20%20down_angle%20%3D%20100%5Cn)%5Cn%5Cn%23%20%E5%A4%84%E7%90%86%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91%5Cnwhile%20cap.isOpened()%3A%5Cn%20%20%20%20%23%20%E8%AF%BB%E5%8F%96%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91%E5%B8%A7%E6%95%B0%5Cn%20%20%20%20success%2C%20im0%20%3D%20cap.read()%5Cn%5Cn%20%20%20%20%23%20%E5%88%A4%E6%96%AD%E6%98%AF%E5%90%A6%E8%AF%BB%E5%8F%96%E6%88%90%E5%8A%9F%5Cn%20%20%20%20if%20not%20success%3A%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20print(%5C%22Video%20frame%20is%20empty%20or%20processing%20is%20complete.%5C%22)%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20break%5Cn%20%20%20%20%5Cn%20%20%20%20%23%20%E5%A4%84%E7%90%86%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91%E5%B8%A7%E6%95%B0%5Cn%20%20%20%20results%20%3D%20gym(im0)%5Cn%5Cncap.release()%5Cncv2.waitKey(0)%5Cncv2.destroyAllWindows()%20%20%23%20destroy%20all%20opened%20windows%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code>import cv2

from ultralytics import solutions

# 读取视频
cap = cv2.VideoCapture("Pushups.demo.video.mp4")
# 判断视频是否读取成功
assert cap.isOpened(), "Error reading video file"

# 初始化AIGym
gym = solutions.AIGym(
    show=True,  # 展示效果
    kpts=[5, 7, 9],  # 处理的关键点
    model="yolo11x-pose.pt",  # 模型路径
    # up_angle = 145,
    down_angle = 100
)

# 处理视频
while cap.isOpened():
    # 读取视频帧数
    success, im0 = cap.read()

    # 判断是否读取成功
    if not success:
        print("Video frame is empty or processing is complete.")
        break
    
    # 处理视频帧数
    results = gym(im0)

cap.release()
cv2.waitKey(0)
cv2.destroyAllWindows()  # destroy all opened windows</code></pre>
<span class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler_container"><img class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler lazyload" height="15" width="15" data-cke-widget-drag-handler="1" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3687401/202508/3687401-20250822165457676-1808144825.gif"></span></div>
<p>整个代码是用Python实现的YOLO运动监测程序，主要用于处理视频帧，识别人体关键点，并计数动作（如俯卧撑）。</p>
<p>它依赖OpenCV（cv2）和Ultralytics的solutions模块。</p>
<h4 id="%E5%AF%BC%E5%85%A5%E6%A8%A1%E5%9D%97">导入模块</h4>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" tabindex="-1" role="region" contenteditable="false" aria-label="代码段 小部件" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="7" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element highlighter-hljs" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22lang%22%3A%22python%22%2C%22code%22%3A%22import%20cv2%5Cn%5Cnfrom%20ultralytics%20import%20solutions%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code>import cv2

from ultralytics import solutions</code></pre>
<span class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler_container"><img class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler lazyload" height="15" width="15" data-cke-widget-drag-handler="1" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3687401/202508/3687401-20250822165457676-1808144825.gif"></span></div>
<ul>
<li><strong>解释</strong>：
<ul>
<li>import cv2：导入OpenCV库，用于视频读取、处理和显示。</li>
<li>from ultralytics import solutions：从Ultralytics库导入solutions模块，其中包含AIGym类，用于AI运动监测（基于YOLO姿态估计）。 这部分是代码的基础，确保所需工具可用。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="%E8%AF%BB%E5%8F%96%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91%E5%B9%B6%E6%A3%80%E6%9F%A5">读取视频并检查</h4>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" tabindex="-1" role="region" contenteditable="false" aria-label="代码段 小部件" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="6" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element highlighter-hljs" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22lang%22%3A%22python%22%2C%22code%22%3A%22%23%E8%AF%BB%E5%8F%96%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91%5Cncap%20%3D%20cv2.VideoCapture(%5C%22Pushups.demo.video.mp4%5C%22)%5Cn%23%E5%88%A4%E6%96%AD%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91%E6%98%AF%E5%90%A6%E8%AF%BB%E5%8F%96%E6%88%90%E5%8A%9F%5Cnassert%20cap.isOpened()%2C%20%5C%22Error%20reading%20video%20file%5C%22%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code>#读取视频
cap = cv2.VideoCapture("Pushups.demo.video.mp4")
#判断视频是否读取成功
assert cap.isOpened(), "Error reading video file"</code></pre>
<span class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler_container"><img class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler lazyload" height="15" width="15" data-cke-widget-drag-handler="1" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3687401/202508/3687401-20250822165457676-1808144825.gif"></span></div>
<ul>
<li><strong>解释</strong>：
<ul>
<li>cap = cv2.VideoCapture("Pushups.demo.video.mp4")：打开指定视频文件（这里是俯卧撑演示视频）。cap是一个视频捕获对象，用于逐帧读取。</li>
<li>assert cap.isOpened(), "Error reading video file"：检查视频是否成功打开。如果失败，抛出错误信息并停止程序。这是一个简单的错误处理，确保视频文件存在且可读。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="%E5%88%9D%E5%A7%8B%E5%8C%96AIGym%E5%AF%B9%E8%B1%A1">初始化AIGym对象</h4>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" tabindex="-1" role="region" contenteditable="false" aria-label="代码段 小部件" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="5" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element highlighter-hljs" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22lang%22%3A%22python%22%2C%22code%22%3A%22%23%20%E5%88%9D%E5%A7%8B%E5%8C%96AIGym%5Cngym%20%3D%20solutions.AIGym(%5Cn%20%20%20%20show%3DTrue%2C%20%20%23%20%E5%B1%95%E7%A4%BA%E6%95%88%E6%9E%9C%5Cn%20%20%20%20kpts%3D%5B5%2C%207%2C%209%5D%2C%20%20%23%20%E5%A4%84%E7%90%86%E7%9A%84%E5%85%B3%E9%94%AE%E7%82%B9%5Cn%20%20%20%20model%3D%5C%22yolo11x-pose.pt%5C%22%2C%20%20%23%20%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E8%B7%AF%E5%BE%84%5Cn%20%20%20%20%23%20up_angle%20%3D%20145%2C%5Cn%20%20%20%20down_angle%20%3D%20100%5Cn)%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code># 初始化AIGym
gym = solutions.AIGym(
    show=True,  # 展示效果
    kpts=[5, 7, 9],  # 处理的关键点
    model="yolo11x-pose.pt",  # 模型路径
    # up_angle = 145,
    down_angle = 100
)</code></pre>
<span class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler_container"><img class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler lazyload" height="15" width="15" data-cke-widget-drag-handler="1" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3687401/202508/3687401-20250822165457676-1808144825.gif"></span></div>
<ul>
<li><strong>解释</strong>：
<ul>
<li>创建AIGym实例，用于运动监测。</li>
<li>show=True：启用实时显示处理后的视频帧（包括标注关键点和角度）。</li>
<li>kpts=[5, 7, 9]：指定人体关键点（基于YOLO的17个姿态节点）。这里是左侧肩膀(5)、肘部(7)、手腕(9)，适合俯卧撑监测。</li>
<li>model="yolo11x-pose.pt"：加载YOLOv11x姿态模型（x版精度高，但计算密集；可换成n/m版以加速）。模型文件需提前下载或通过Ultralytics自动获取。</li>
<li>up_angle = 145：伸展角度阈值（默认145度，表示动作伸展状态）。</li>
<li>down_angle = 100：设置收缩角度阈值（小于此值视为收缩状态）。用于判断动作周期（up到down再回up计数一次）。这里调整为100度，可能适应特定动作如压腿。 这部分是核心配置，定义了监测的关节和阈值。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="%E5%A4%84%E7%90%86%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91%E5%B8%A7%E7%9A%84%E5%BE%AA%E7%8E%AF">处理视频帧的循环</h4>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" tabindex="-1" role="region" contenteditable="false" aria-label="代码段 小部件" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="4" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element highlighter-hljs" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22lang%22%3A%22python%22%2C%22code%22%3A%22%23%20%E5%A4%84%E7%90%86%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91%5Cnwhile%20cap.isOpened()%3A%5Cn%20%20%20%20%23%20%E8%AF%BB%E5%8F%96%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91%E5%B8%A7%E6%95%B0%5Cn%20%20%20%20success%2C%20im0%20%3D%20cap.read()%5Cn%5Cn%20%20%20%20%23%20%E5%88%A4%E6%96%AD%E6%98%AF%E5%90%A6%E8%AF%BB%E5%8F%96%E6%88%90%E5%8A%9F%5Cn%20%20%20%20if%20not%20success%3A%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20print(%5C%22Video%20frame%20is%20empty%20or%20processing%20is%20complete.%5C%22)%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20break%5Cn%20%20%20%20%5Cn%20%20%20%20%23%20%E5%A4%84%E7%90%86%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91%E5%B8%A7%E6%95%B0%5Cn%20%20%20%20results%20%3D%20gym(im0)%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code># 处理视频
while cap.isOpened():
    # 读取视频帧数
    success, im0 = cap.read()

    # 判断是否读取成功
    if not success:
        print("Video frame is empty or processing is complete.")
        break
    
    # 处理视频帧数
    results = gym(im0)</code></pre>
<span class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler_container"><img class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler lazyload" height="15" width="15" data-cke-widget-drag-handler="1" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3687401/202508/3687401-20250822165457676-1808144825.gif"></span></div>
<ul>
<li><strong>解释</strong>：
<ul>
<li>while cap.isOpened()：循环处理视频，直到结束或关闭。</li>
<li>success, im0 = cap.read()：读取一帧视频。success是布尔值（True表示读取成功），im0是当前帧图像。</li>
<li>if not success: ... break：如果读取失败（视频结束），打印消息并退出循环。</li>
<li>results = gym(im0)：将当前帧传入AIGym处理。它会使用YOLO检测关键点、计算角度、更新计数，并返回结果（可能包括标注后的图像）。由于show=True，会自动显示处理效果。 这是一个主循环，实现实时视频处理。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="%C2%A0%E9%87%8A%E6%94%BE%E8%B5%84%E6%BA%90%E5%92%8C%E7%AD%89%E5%BE%85">&nbsp;释放资源和等待</h4>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" tabindex="-1" role="region" contenteditable="false" aria-label="代码段 小部件" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="3" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element highlighter-hljs" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22lang%22%3A%22python%22%2C%22code%22%3A%22cap.release()%5Cncv2.waitKey(0)%5Cncv2.destroyAllWindows()%20%20%23%20destroy%20all%20opened%20windows%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code>cap.release()
cv2.waitKey(0)
cv2.destroyAllWindows()  # destroy all opened windows</code></pre>
<span class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler_container"><img class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler lazyload" height="15" width="15" data-cke-widget-drag-handler="1" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3687401/202508/3687401-20250822165457676-1808144825.gif"></span></div>
<ul>
<li><strong>解释</strong>：
<ul>
<li>cap.release()：释放视频捕获对象，关闭视频文件。</li>
<li>cv2.waitKey(0)：等待按键输入（0表示无限等待），防止窗口立即关闭。用户可按任意键退出。</li>
<li>cv2.destroyAllWindows()：关闭所有OpenCV窗口。 这部分是清理操作，确保程序优雅结束。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="%E6%95%B4%E4%BD%93%E8%BF%90%E8%A1%8C%E9%80%BB%E8%BE%91">整体运行逻辑</h3>
<ul>
<li>程序读取视频，初始化YOLO监测对象，逐帧处理（检测关键点、计算角度、计数），实时显示结果。</li>
<li>适用于俯卧撑（通过肘部弯曲计数），可修改kpts、model和角度阈值扩展到其他动作（如深蹲）。</li>
<li>注意：需确保YOLO模型文件存在；如果电脑配置低，大模型如x版可能卡顿。</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="%E4%B8%8D%E5%90%8C%E5%8A%A8%E4%BD%9C%E7%A4%BA%E4%BE%8B">不同动作示例</h2>
<h3 id="%E6%B7%B1%E8%B9%B2%E7%9B%91%E6%B5%8B">深蹲监测</h3>
<p>更换kpts=[6,12,14]，视频为深蹲文件。效果：完美识别角度变化，计数4次。</p>
<p><img alt="图3" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3687401/202509/3687401-20250910110851828-1724490439.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="%E5%8E%8B%E8%85%BF%E7%9B%91%E6%B5%8B">压腿监测</h3>
<p>kpts=[11,13,15]，初始用"yolo11n-pose.pt"可能识别不准，换"yolo11x-pose.pt"。调整down_angle=100</p>
<p><img alt="图4" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3687401/202509/3687401-20250910110901769-2033568850.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 id="%E9%AB%98%E6%8A%AC%E8%85%BF%E7%9B%91%E6%B5%8B">高抬腿监测</h3>
<p>kpts=[12,14,16]，用"yolo11m-pose.pt"。视频中动作9次，程序准确计数。</p>
<p><img alt="图1" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3687401/202509/3687401-20250910110918803-2048067498.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>注意：根据动作实际情况，动态调整节点、模型和角度阈值。</p>
<p>电脑配置低时，用小模型；精度不足时，用大模型。</p>
